by.quote: 4. MEDIUM: The CG-to-classroom hard cut shows an empty room, then Natsuki fades back in ... Fix: swap the two lines so the sprite is already on stage under the CG. Then use @cg - fade, or a short dissolve, so the CG resolves onto her.

by.quote: The "super tall" setup is dropped. Part 2 spends a whole exchange on the rumour that she's "Taller than the vice-principal!", and then nothing in her entrance mentions her height: no "she really is tall" and no "she isn't actually tall". image_02 doesn't read as especially tall either; she looks average against the blackboard. Either pay it off in one line of narration or I'm left wondering whether the rumour was wrong.

"Super tall" never pays off. Rika's whole setup is "she's super tall, taller than the vice-principal." Neither the illustration nor the narration confirms it ... in the picture she looks average ... Either the narration should register it ("Rika was right about the height") or the art should sell it.

Height: Rika's whole bit is that she's "super tall. Taller than the vice-principal!" Nothing in the CG sells unusual height. With no adult or classmate standing beside her for scale, she reads as an ordinary-height girl. If height matters later, this CG undercuts it.

items.why: Reader1 flags the rumor line as clashing with her plainly average height and raises that the rumor may be wrong, which cutting it resolves; reader2 and reader3 flag the same line but want the art or narration to make her tall, the opposite direction. Continuity explicitly passed the joke.
Onmodel passed "a cut across the back of it" as matching the CG, all three readers called it a match, and continuity logged it as a [P] detail; nobody raised the inside-of-wrist mismatch.
